description: Three drum voices, each one waveform with a falling pitch envelope and a falling amplitude envelope fired by a trigger

params.text: Sets the base frequency of that voice, 35Hz at the counter-clockwise end to 335Hz at the clockwise end, or the filter cutoff when that voice is set to noise
Sets how long the pitch takes to drop back to the base frequency after a trigger, up to 500ms
Sets how long that voice takes to fall to silence after a trigger, up to 500ms

inputs.text: Sets the level of that voice, 0-10V running from silence to full; with nothing patched the voice stays silent
A rising edge here fires that voice
Adds to the base frequency of that voice, 0-10V covering the whole 300Hz range of the freq knob

notes: each voice plays one of five waveforms, chosen with its own button strip: sine, triangle, square, saw or noise
a voice is silent until its LVL input carries voltage: the level is taken from that jack alone and there is no level knob
a voice fires on a rising edge at its TRIG input, so both LVL and TRIG have to be patched before anything is heard

inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
